description: Sends a message from a user to the VertoDigital team and returns a reference ID. The message lands in the team's CRM and inbox, and the team replies to fromEmail, normally within one business day. Use it for service questions, partnerships, press and careers, or to request the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment: set topic: "assessment" and put the company and main pipeline challenge in message. If the user only wants contact details, use vertodigital_get_contact instead. Call it only with the user's consent, using their real name and email. Pass organization whenever the user names their company; it is saved as the company on the CRM record. Every call creates a new enquiry, so do not retry a call that succeeded. Calls are rate-limited: over the limit, the tool returns an isError result with a retry delay in seconds. No authentication required.

fromEmail.description: Email address the team should reply to

fromName.description: Full name of the person sending the enquiry

organization.description: Company or organization name, saved as the company on the CRM record

topic.description: "assessment": request the free Pipeline Readiness Assessment. "services": questions about working with VertoDigital. "partnership", "press", "careers": as named. "general" (default): anything else.

name: vertodigital_send_enquiry
